query: WITH sampled AS (SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at) SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM sampled.observed_at)::double precision AS "observed_at!", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM oldest.finished_at + $1::interval)::double precision AS "oldest?" FROM sampled LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT finished_at FROM background_jobs WHERE state = 'completed' AND finished_at <= sampled.observed_at - $1::interval ORDER BY finished_at LIMIT 1 ) AS oldest ON true
